items.title: Harold Christophe Interview, 1961-08-01
items.q: oh, Louis, won't you, for God's sake, Louis, with that guitar. Won't you put it down?

ctx.x: Yeah, I wish I could hear it.

And sometimes he'd stay there all night long playing that guitar. Late at night. And sometime my mother would see behind, oh, Louis, won't you, for God's sake, Louis, with that guitar. Won't you put it down? Say, what a similar like me running in the house. Well, I'm never lonely, but all the neighbors, they know that. They know when I'm at home. Well, I get in here all day long and I start with music. But it's an outlet. You'll never get lonesome. Nothing like that. And you've always got company. Yeah, you've…
Did anybody in your family play piano too? Did you have a piano in your home?
